instructions: ["Loosen tea leaves with oil and lime in a bowl.","Add rice and toss until coated.","Season with fish sauce (or soy).","Fold in peanuts, sesame, and fried garlic; serve."]

title: Burmese Coconut Fish Curry
description: Fish simmered in coconut milk with turmeric, onion, and gentle heat.
ingredients: [{"name":"Fish (firm white fish)","amount":"600 g"},{"name":"Coconut milk","amount":"400 ml"},{"name":"Onion","amount":"1 medium, sliced"},{"name":"Garlic","amount":"4 cloves"},{"name":"Ginger","amount":"1 inch, minced"},{"name":"Turmeric","amount":"1/2 tsp"},{"name":"Fish sauce","amount":"1–2 tbsp"},{"name":"Oil","amount":"2 tbsp"},{"name":"Water","amount":"1/2 cup"}]
instructions: ["Sauté onion, garlic, and ginger in oil until fragrant.","Add turmeric, then coconut milk and water; simmer 5 minutes.","Add fish and simmer gently 10–12 minutes until cooked through.","Season with fish sauce; serve with rice."]

title: Burmese Tomato & Pea Curry
description: Simple home-style curry of tomatoes and peas with garlic and turmeric.
ingredients: [{"name":"Tomatoes","amount":"4 medium, chopped"},{"name":"Green peas","amount":"1 1/2 cups"},{"name":"Garlic","amount":"4 cloves, minced"},{"name":"Onion","amount":"1 medium, sliced"},{"name":"Turmeric","amount":"1/2 tsp"},{"name":"Oil","amount":"2 tbsp"},{"name":"Salt","amount":"to taste"}]
instructions: ["Sauté onion and garlic in oil until soft.","Add turmeric and tomatoes; cook until tomatoes break down.","Add peas and a splash of water; simmer 8–10 minutes.","Season with salt and serve with rice."]

title: Burmese Lime Chili Cucumber Salad
description: Crunchy cucumber salad with lime, chili, and toasted sesame.
ingredients: [{"name":"Cucumber","amount":"3 cups, sliced"},{"name":"Lime juice","amount":"2 tbsp"},{"name":"Salt","amount":"1/2 tsp"},{"name":"Sugar","amount":"1 tsp"},{"name":"Chili flakes","amount":"to taste"},{"name":"Sesame seeds","amount":"1 tbsp"}]
instructions: ["Toss cucumber with salt and rest 5 minutes; drain lightly.","Mix lime juice and sugar, then toss with cucumber.","Add chili flakes and sesame seeds; serve."]

title: Mont Sein Paung (Burmese Sweet Semolina Pudding)
description: Soft semolina pudding cooked with coconut milk and sugar, served warm or chilled.
ingredients: [{"name":"Semolina","amount":"1 cup"},{"name":"Coconut milk","amount":"400 ml"},{"name":"Water","amount":"1 cup"},{"name":"Sugar","amount":"1/2 cup"},{"name":"Salt","amount":"pinch"}]
instructions: ["Bring coconut milk, water, sugar, and salt to a gentle simmer.","Whisk in semolina slowly to avoid lumps.","Cook, stirring, until thick and glossy (8–10 minutes).
column14: Pour into bowls and cool slightly before serving.""]"

title: Burmese Garlic Chicken Stir-Fry
description: Quick stir-fried chicken with lots of garlic, soy, and a squeeze of lime.
ingredients: [{"name":"Chicken thigh (sliced)","amount":"500 g"},{"name":"Garlic","amount":"8 cloves, sliced"},{"name":"Soy sauce","amount":"2 tbsp"},{"name":"Fish sauce (optional)","amount":"1 tbsp"},{"name":"Oil","amount":"2 tbsp"},{"name":"Lime","amount":"1/2, juiced"},{"name":"Black pepper","amount":"1/2 tsp"}]
instructions: ["Heat oil and fry garlic until just golden.","Add chicken and stir-fry until cooked through.","Add soy (and fish sauce if using) and pepper; toss 1 minute.","Finish with lime juice and serve with rice."]
